scope: Retrospective replay of actual merged ELF project decisions, not a live multi-week customer trial. No synthetic project facts or private chat transcripts.

checkpoints.title: After PR 409: source context and native citations
After PR 410: source-only recall and historical time
After PR 411: claim dependencies and agent integration

tasks.request: 你接手 ELF 的召回修复工作。根据当前项目记录，说明已交付的来源读取能力、仍缺失的关键材料，以及下一步最小改动范围。不要把已有分数当作全部问题已解决；请给出可追溯的依据。
acceptance: Identify native evidence-pack/source reference support and its binding-only guarantee.
Identify the missing Cedar August 15 source in the current selected context and recommend independent original-source discovery.
Do not claim that supplemental recall or caller alias authority is already delivered at this checkpoint.

tasks.request: 上一阶段之后 ELF 已合并 PR 410。请给下一位工程师一份简短交接：哪些原先的召回和历史时间问题已经解决，哪些问题仍应继续处理？不要重复建议已经完成的工作，也不要宣称整体引用分数已经提升。
acceptance: Recognize shipped original-text supplemental recall and historical graph status at requested as_of.
Explain caller-authorized aliases versus unknown/extracted aliases without automatic identity merging.
Report factual 32/32 and strict 30/32 with the two remaining Cobalt citation-bridge failures; do not claim native claim dependencies are delivered yet.

tasks.request: ELF 又合并了 PR 411。我们现在要接入一个新的 Agent 客户端，请说明跨文档结论应怎样提交和显示引用、旧调用是否必须修改、以及当前仍不能放心交给自动化决策的字段。
acceptance: Explain optional backward depends_on and rendering the returned resolved_citations including premise sources.
Explain that requests without dependencies preserve the old shape and source-binding checks do not prove entailment.
Identify supported versus conflict/unknown/absent label errors as remaining limitations, with 7/10 all-four result rather than universal success.

tasks.request: 换一个新会话接手 ELF：根据截至 PR 411 的项目资料，决定下一步该修什么、该保留什么架构、应怎样验证真实项目价值。请区分已经验证的结论和仍未验证的产品优势，不要继续扩大数据库或图谱范围。
acceptance: Prioritize reliable structured-state interpretation and real project validation rather than claiming the small fixture proves general reliability.
Retain PostgreSQL plus Qdrant and 4096-dimensional embeddings; do not infer a need for a database migration.
Explain that the prior evaluation supplied all case sources, measured source reading and citation composition, and did not establish independent graph benefit or customer readiness.

conditions.description: Fresh agent with a bounded frozen repository/history reader. No ELF retrieval or persistent derived memory.
Same repository/history plus a persistent index of exactly the same immutable sources. No derived memories.
Same source access plus native persistent ELF extraction and recall across checkpoints.

controls.condition_order: Rotate conditions per task; no carryover conversation; full-ELF state persists only through chronological checkpoints.

interpretation: Primary memory-value contrast is full_elf versus source_only with the same original corpus.
No-ELF retains repository/history access; the experiment must not manufacture a win by withholding source facts.
Count ingestion, extraction, embeddings, indexing readiness and failed calls; do not report only cheap successful queries.
One run per cell is diagnostic, not statistical evidence. Do not pool old synthetic scores.
A complete comparison requires all three conditions for every evaluated task. A partial or blocked run has no product ranking.
No native execution, latency, cost saving, cross-session success or customer readiness is inferred from preparation-only checks.
